basic_info.description: Significant improvements have just updated this 4bd 1.5ba into a modern and comfortable home. The home has new plumbing, heating, wiring & breaker panel, flooring, and sewer lateral. The Kitchen and laundry room were taken down to the studs, and both bathrooms were completely remodeled. Other updates include new cabinets and countertops in the kitchen, new lighting throughout, interior and exterior paint, new garage door, and new W/D & utility sink in the dedicated laundry room. See disclosures for the full list of improvements. The yard is fully fenced, and has raised beds for gardening and beautiful views of Sutro Tower.  Easy access to MUNI, 101, Bayview Park, and Candlestick Point.
